record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose this. Most reading is about the phase in hand; the effort view and history are one key away for catching up or checking why a choice changed.

## Counter-argument

Always showing the whole effort makes the log one stable document, and the history is exactly what a reader returning after a break needs.

payload.alternatives: always the whole effort with superseded inline and dimmed; this phase's active decisions only
payload.choice: The Decisions tab shows the phase's decisions by default, a toggles the whole effort grouped by phase, and h toggles superseded decisions shown under their successors
